Research

I’m a fourth-year undergraduate in applied physics at Peking University. My research advisors are Prof. Yuan Wang and Prof. Meng Li.

Research Interests

I’m interested in embodied intelligence and hardware–software co-design. In particular, I’m interested in how FPGA-based accelerators can run large models efficiently.
